selectionReason: Both top-two methods passed8/8 development tasks under both reviewers. Keyword search is the simpler default; dense search must demonstrate additional benefit.
acceptance: At least two more independent cases than direct per repetition under both fixed-criterion reviewers, with no new prerequisite/authority/runtime-proof regression. Report per-case and per-repetition results, not independent-sample claims from repeats. No source/prompt/cutoff change after holdout inputs are opened. The semantic dependency is adopted only if it adds a clear heldout benefit over the simpler lexical method without new safety failures.
limits: Synthetic context-use cohort, not arithmetic, human UAT or production-path integration. Embedding responses report a configured tag; installed artifact digest is independently checked. The comparison matches original evidence availability and generation settings; selected context differs by treatment. It does not prove wrapper superiority with manually identical selected excerpts.
